def get_bytes(self, size: int) -> bytes:
        """Extract the requested number of bytes from the packet"""

        if self._idx + size > self._len:
            raise PacketDecodeError('Incomplete packet')

        value = self._packet[self._idx:self._idx+size]
        self._idx += size
        return value
